HAYVON TANASI QISMLARI:
  fur      — jun (sutemizuvchilarda)
  fins     — suzgichlar (baliq va delfinda)
  a tail   — dum
  skin     — teri (junsiz)
  feathers — patlar (qushlarda)
  wings    — qanotlar
  a mane   — yol (sherning bo'ynidagi soch)
  legs     — oyoqlar

IKKI GURUH HAYVON:
  birds (qushlar)      — pat va qanoti bor, tuxum qo'yadi
  mammals (sutemizuvchilar) — bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi

QIZIQ FAKTLAR:
  • Delfin — BALIQ EMAS, sutemizuvchi!
  • Pingvin — QUSH, lekin UCHA OLMAYDI!
  • Delfinning OYOG'I YO'Q va JUNI YO'Q — terisi bor.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT GURUH:
  reptiles  — sudralib yuruvchilar (timsoh, ilon, kaltakesak)
              teri qattiq va tangachali, tuxum qo'yadi
  mammals   — sutemizuvchilar (ot, maymun, mushuk, it, sigir)
              bola tug'adi, sut bilan boqadi, juni bor
  insects   — hasharotlar (kapalak, ari, chumoli)
              olti oyoq, ko'pincha qanot bor
  birds     — qushlar (xo'roz, burgut, to'tiqush)
              pat, qanot, tumshuq; tuxum qo'yadi

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: 'Crocodiles are reptiles.'
DIQQAT: gap KO'PLIKDA tuziladi — Crocodile'S are reptile'S'.

tasks.whyUz: Ilon — sudralib yuruvchi. Timsoh bilan bir guruhda.

Kapalak — hasharot. Qanoti bor, lekin qush EMAS: pati yo'q, olti oyog'i bor.
'butterfly' → ko'plikda 'butterflies' (y → ies).
Xo'roz — qush. Pat, qanot va tumshug'i bor.
Ot bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi.
'monkey' → ko'plikda 'monkeys' (unlidan keyin y → faqat -s).
Mushuk — sutemizuvchi, juni bor.
It — sutemizuvchi.
Sigir sut beradi — eng aniq sutemizuvchi.

exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI: paws, feathers, fur, tail, beak, ears

RASMDA UCHTA HAYVON BOR:
  Yuqorida — yirtqich qush (an eagle)
  O'rtada  — yo'lbars (a tiger)
  Pastda   — kenguru (a kangaroo)

KITOBDA BERILGAN YORLIQLAR:
  Qush:    sharp claws (o'tkir tirnoqlar), wings (qanotlar)
  Yo'lbars: whiskers (mo'ylovlar), black stripes (qora chiziqlar)
  Kenguru:  front legs (old oyoqlar), pouch (xalta),
            back legs (orqa oyoqlar), feet (panjalar)

DIQQAT — QAYSI HAYVONDA QAYSI SO'Z:
  beak, feathers — faqat QUSHDA
  fur, paws      — faqat SUTEMIZUVCHIDA
  tail, ears     — ko'p hayvonda

⚠ SURATDAGI QUSh — BURGUT EMAS:

  Mashq javobi 'an eagle' (burgut) deb
  kutiladi, lekin suratdagi qush aslida
  QIZIL DUMLI QARChIG'AY (a red-tailed
  hawk).

  ⚠ Qanday farqlanadi:
     BURGUT — oyoqlari barmoqlarigacha
        PAT bilan qoplangan
     QARChIG'AY — oyoqlari YALANG'OCh
        va SARIQ

  ⚠ Suratdagi qushning dumi zangori-qizil,
  ko'kragi oqish-chipor, oyoqlari sariq va
  yalang'och — ya'ni qarchig'ay.

  ⚠ Mashq uchun javob 'an eagle' qoladi,
  lekin haqiqatni bilib qo'ying.

exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR — 40-betdagi matnlardan olingan.

ESLAB QOLING (bu birikmalar yodlanadi):
  feed somebody ON something — biror narsa bilan boqmoq
  weigh FROM ... TO ...       — ...dan ...gacha og'irlikda

  the ice OF Antarctica      — Antarktidaning muzi (egalik)

IN yoki ON?

  ON — yuzasida: on the ice, on an island, on the grass

tasks.en: Dolphins are mammals.
tasks.note: 'a mammal' = sutemizuvchi. Ko'plikda 'mammals'.

tasks.en: They have babies and feed them on milk.
tasks.uz: Ular bola tug'adi va ularni sut bilan boqadi.
tasks.note: Bu SUTEMIZUVCHINING ta'rifi. 'feed somebody ON something' — 'on' predlogi bilan.

tasks.en: Dolphins are not fish, but they live in water.
tasks.uz: Delfinlar baliq emas, lekin suvda yashaydi.
tasks.note: Eng ko'p chalkashadigan fakt! 'fish' — ko'plikda ham 'fish'.

tasks.en: They can swim very well.
tasks.note: 'can' + fe'l (asos shakli). 'very well' — juda yaxshi.

tasks.en: They haven't got legs.
tasks.note: 'have got' inkori. Ko'plik ega → HAVEN'T.

tasks.en: They've got grey skin and a big smile.
tasks.uz: Ularning kulrang terisi va katta tabassumi bor.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: smile = tabassum. Delfinning og'zi tabassumga o'xshaydi.

tasks.en: They've also got fins and a tail to help them swim.
tasks.uz: Yana suzishga yordam beradigan suzgichlari va dumi bor.
tasks.note: 'to help them swim' — maqsad. 'help somebody DO' — 'to' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.en: They weigh from seventy to five hundred kilos.
tasks.uz: Ular yetmishdan besh yuz kilogrammgacha og'irlikda.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: weigh = og'irlikda bo'lmoq. O'qilishi /weɪ/ — 'gh' o'qilmaydi!

tasks.en: Dolphins are very intelligent animals.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: intelligent = aqlli. 'clever' bilan bir xil, lekin kuchliroq.

tasks.en: They can easily learn how to play games and are friendly to people.
tasks.uz: Ular o'yin o'ynashni oson o'rganadi va odamlarga do'stona munosabatda bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: easily = oson; friendly = do'stona.
'friendly TO somebody' — predlog shart.

tasks.en: Dolphins live in warm seas in many different parts of the world.
tasks.uz: Delfinlar dunyoning ko'p turli qismlaridagi iliq dengizlarda yashaydi.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'ZLAR: warm seas = iliq dengizlar; parts of the world = dunyo qismlari.

tasks.en: They live in small groups and they eat fish.
tasks.uz: Ular kichik guruhlarda yashaydi va baliq yeydi.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: groups = guruhlar. 'live IN groups' — predlog shart.

tasks.en: They live for about fifty years.
tasks.note: 'live FOR + davomiylik' — 'for' shart. 'about' = taxminan.

exercises.explanationUz:
PINGVIN — G'AYRIODDIY QUSH.

U qushning barcha belgilariga ega:
  tuxum qo'yadi (lay eggs)
  qanoti bor (wings)
  pati bor (feathers)

LEKIN UCHA OLMAYDI! Buning o'rniga juda yaxshi suzadi.
Qanotlari suv ostida 'eshkak' vazifasini bajaradi.

⚠ MATN VA SURAT NOMUVOFIQLIGI:

  Matnda: pingvinlar 'weigh about twenty
  kilos' (taxminan 20 kilo).

  ⚠ Bu — IMPERATOR pingvinning og'irligi
  (20-40 kg).

  ⚠ C-suratdagilar esa ADELI pingvinlari —
  ular atigi 4-6 kg keladi.

  ⚠ Kitob umumlashtirib yozgan.


⚠ UMUMLAShTIRISh:

  'Penguins live on the ice of Antarctica'

  ⚠ Aslida pingvinlarning ko'p turi
  Antarktidadan TAShQARIDA yashaydi:
  Galapagos, Janubiy Afrika, Yangi
  Zelandiya, Chili.

  ⚠ Boshlang'ich daraja uchun
  soddalashtirilgan.

tasks.en: Penguins lay eggs and they've got wings, so they are like other birds, but they can't fly!
tasks.uz: Pingvinlar tuxum qo'yadi va qanotlari bor, shuning uchun ular boshqa qushlarga o'xshaydi, lekin ucha olmaydi!
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: lay eggs = tuxum qo'ymoq.
'so' = shuning uchun. 'like other birds' = boshqa qushlar kabi.

tasks.en: They can swim very well, though.
tasks.uz: Lekin ular juda yaxshi suza oladi.
tasks.note: 'though' gap OXIRIDA — 'lekin, esa' ma'nosida.

tasks.en: They are black and white, and they've got small wings, very short legs and a short tail.
tasks.uz: Ular qora va oq rangda, kichik qanotlari, juda kalta oyoqlari va kalta dumi bor.
tasks.note: Rang: 'black and white' — tartib o'zgarmaydi.

tasks.en: They've also got thick feathers to keep them warm in cold water.
tasks.uz: Yana sovuq suvda issiq saqlash uchun qalin patlari bor.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: thick = qalin; warm = issiq; cold water = sovuq suv.
'keep somebody warm' = issiq saqlamoq.

tasks.en: They weigh about twenty kilos.
tasks.note: Delfin 70–500 kg, pingvin esa atigi 20 kg.

tasks.en: Penguins look funny when they walk.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: funny = kulgili. 'look' + sifat = ...ko'rinadi.

tasks.en: However, when they are in the water, they swim like fish.
tasks.uz: Ammo suvda bo'lganda ular baliqdek suzadi.
tasks.note:
'However' = ammo (gap boshida, vergul bilan).
'like fish' = baliq kabi.

tasks.en: Penguins live on the ice of Antarctica and in the sea around it.
tasks.uz: Pingvinlar Antarktida muzida va uning atrofidagi dengizda yashaydi.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: ice = muz. 'ON the ice' — yuza → ON. 'around' = atrofida.

tasks.en: They live in big groups and they eat fish.
tasks.uz: Ular katta guruhlarda yashaydi va baliq yeydi.
tasks.note: Delfin KICHIK guruhlarda, pingvin KATTA guruhlarda.

tasks.en: They live for about twenty years.
tasks.note: Delfin 50 yil, pingvin 20 yil.

  'They eat fish.'            — ikkala matnda ham

tasks.whyUz: 'a big smile' — delfinning og'zi tabassumga o'xshaydi.
O'qilishi /weɪ/ — 'gh' o'qilmaydi! Ot shakli: weight (og'irlik).

exercises.instructionUz: Koalalar haqidagi matnni o'qing va to'g'ri so'zning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN (to'g'ri variantlar bilan):

  Koalas are MAMMALS and, like dolphins, they have babies and
  feed them on MILK. Mothers carry their young in a small pouch
  for the first six months of their lives. Koalas can CLIMB very
  well. They can swim very well, too. They have got thick, GREY
  fur and a big, black nose. They've also got very sharp CLAWS.
  Koalas live and sleep in the tops of eucalyptus trees in
  eastern AUSTRALIA. They live alone and eat eucalyptus leaves.
  Koalas live for about FIFTEEN years.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Koalalar — sutemizuvchilar va delfinlar kabi bola tug'adi hamda
  ularni sut bilan boqadi. Onalari bolasini birinchi olti oy
  davomida kichik xaltada olib yuradi. Koalalar juda yaxshi
  daraxtga chiqa oladi. Ular juda yaxshi suza ham oladi. Ularning
  qalin, kulrang juni va katta qora burni bor. Yana juda o'tkir
  tirnoqlari bor. Koalalar sharqiy Avstraliyadagi evkalipt
  daraxtlarining tepasida yashaydi va uxlaydi. Ular yolg'iz
  yashaydi va evkalipt bargini yeydi. Koalalar taxminan o'n besh
  yil yashaydi.

  Where do they live?        → joy
  How often do you clean it? → NECHA MARTA (chastota)

DIQQAT — 'HOW OFTEN':
  'How often ...?' = qanchalik tez-tez? necha marta?
  Javob: once a week, twice a week, two or three times a week,
         every morning, every day

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 → B.

QUYONLARNING NOMI: Hansel va Gretel — mashhur nemis ertagidagi
aka-singilning ismlari.

tasks.right: E  Two or three times a week.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi matnni o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PLAKAT SARLAVHASI:
  GREY SEALS NEED YOU — Kulrang tyulenlarga siz keraksiz
  Learn about them and save them — Ular haqida bilib oling va
                                    ularni saqlab qoling

Bu — TABIATNI MUHOFAZA QILISH plakati.
Oxirida: 'TO FIND OUT MORE ABOUT WHAT YOU CAN DO TO SAVE
THEM CALL 911 7063'
  = Ularni saqlab qolish uchun nima qila olishingizni bilmoqchi
    bo'lsangiz, 911 7063 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

tasks.en: These lovely mammals live in the north-east and north-west parts of the Atlantic and in the Baltic sea.
tasks.uz: Bu yoqimli sutemizuvchilar Atlantikaning shimoli-sharqiy va shimoli-g'arbiy qismlarida hamda Boltiq dengizida yashaydi.
tasks.note:
'lovely' = yoqimli, chiroyli.
Yo'nalishlar: north-east (shimoli-sharq), north-west (shimoli-g'arb).
'the Atlantic', 'the Baltic sea' — dengiz/okean nomlari THE bilan.

tasks.en: They are great swimmers and can swim very fast.
tasks.uz: Ular ajoyib suzuvchilar va juda tez suza oladi.
tasks.note:
'a swimmer' = suzuvchi (swim + -er).
'great' bu yerda 'ajoyib' ma'nosida.

tasks.en: They are also excellent divers and can stay underwater for about 15 minutes.
tasks.uz: Ular yana zo'r sho'ng'uvchilar va suv ostida taxminan 15 daqiqa tura oladi.
tasks.note:
'a diver' = sho'ng'uvchi (dive + -r).
'excellent' = a'lo, zo'r. 'underwater' = suv ostida.
'stay FOR + vaqt' — 'for' shart.

tasks.en: Grey seals have got big eyes to help them see well in dark waters, as well as long whiskers and thick grey fur to keep them warm in cold seas.
tasks.uz: Kulrang tyulenlarning qorong'i suvlarda yaxshi ko'rish uchun katta ko'zlari, shuningdek uzun mo'ylovlari va sovuq dengizlarda issiq saqlash uchun qalin kulrang juni bor.
tasks.note:
'as well as' = shuningdek, va yana.
'to help them see' — 'help somebody DO' ('to' YO'Q).
'keep them warm' — Coursebook 40-betdagi pingvin matnidagi ibora.

tasks.en: They weigh from 150 to 230 kilos.
tasks.note: 'from ... to ...' — oraliq (Coursebook 42-bet, 7-mashq).

tasks.en: They eat various kinds of fish and they spend most of their time in the sea.
tasks.uz: Ular har xil baliqlarni yeydi va vaqtining ko'pini dengizda o'tkazadi.
tasks.note:
'various kinds of' = har xil turdagi.
'spend time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq. 'most of' = ko'p qismi.

tasks.en: When they are not in the water, they like to rest and dry their coat on rocky islands or sandy beaches.
tasks.uz: Suvda bo'lmaganda, ular toshli orollarda yoki qumli plyajlarda dam olishni va terisini quritishni yoqtiradi.
tasks.note:
'to rest' = dam olmoq; 'to dry' = quritmoq.
'a coat' bu yerda = hayvonning juni/terisi.
'rocky' = toshli (rock + -y), 'sandy' = qumli (sand + -y).

tasks.en: Grey seals live for about 25 to 30 years.
tasks.note: 'live FOR + davomiylik'.

tasks.en: To find out more about what you can do to save them call 911 7063.
tasks.uz: Ularni saqlab qolish uchun nima qila olishingizni bilish uchun 911 7063 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
tasks.note:
'to find out' = bilib olmoq, aniqlamoq.
'to save' = saqlab qolmoq, qutqarmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Then put the words in the sentences that follow in the correct order, to form questions. Finally, answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng quyidagi so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda joylashtirib savol tuzing. Nihoyat, savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TARTIBI:
  So'roq so'zi + yordamchi fe'l (do/does/is/are/have) + ega + fe'l?

MISOL:
  'grey seals / are / what?'
  → What ARE grey seals?
    (so'roq so'zi → 'be' → ega)

  'where / live / they / do?'
  → Where DO they LIVE?
    (so'roq so'zi → do → ega → fe'l)

DIQQAT: 'have got' bilan savol:
  → What HAVE they GOT?  ('do' KERAK EMAS)

tasks.whyUz:
'be' fe'li so'roq so'zidan keyin, egadan oldin turadi.
JAVOB: They are (lovely) mammals.

So'roq so'zi → DO → ega → fe'l.
JAVOB: They live in the north-east and north-west parts of the Atlantic and in the Baltic sea.

'can' yordamchi fe'l — 'do' KERAK EMAS.
Oxirgi 'do' — asosiy fe'l ('qilmoq').
JAVOB: They can swim very fast and they can stay underwater for about 15 minutes.

'have got' bilan 'do' KERAK EMAS: What HAVE they GOT?
JAVOB: They have got big eyes, long whiskers and thick grey fur.

tasks.prompt: have / they got / why / big eyes?
tasks.answer: Why have they got big eyes?
tasks.whyUz:
'Why' + have + ega + got + ot?
JAVOB: To help them see well in dark waters.
(Sabab javobida 'To ...' yoki 'Because ...' ishlatiladi.)
tasks.speak: have / they got / why / big eyes?

tasks.whyUz:
Og'irlik → HOW MUCH + DO + ega + weigh?
JAVOB: They weigh from 150 to 230 kilos.

So'roq so'zi → DO → ega → fe'l.
JAVOB: They eat various kinds of fish.

tasks.prompt: do / they / how long / live for?
tasks.answer: How long do they live for?
tasks.whyUz:
'How long' + DO + ega + live FOR?
'for' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
JAVOB: They live for about 25 to 30 years.
tasks.speak: do / they / how long / live for?

Matn ikki xatboshidan iborat:

Bu tuzilish 16-mashqdagi yozma ish uchun namuna bo'ladi.

tasks.en: They lay eggs and keep them in a nest.
tasks.uz: Ular tuxum qo'yadi va uni uyada saqlaydi.
tasks.note:
'lay eggs' = tuxum qo'ymoq. 'a nest' = uya.
'keep them' — 'them' = tuxumlar.

tasks.en: They are excellent hunters.
tasks.note: 'a hunter' = ovchi (hunt + -er). 'excellent' = a'lo, zo'r.

tasks.en: They can see very well and they can fly very fast.
tasks.uz: Ular juda yaxshi ko'ra oladi va juda tez ucha oladi.
tasks.note: Coursebook 42-betdagi viktorinada ham: 'Eagles can't see well' — NOTO'G'RI edi.

tasks.en: They have got big wings and long tails.
tasks.uz: Ularning katta qanotlari va uzun dumlari bor.
tasks.note: 'wings' va 'tails' — ko'plikda, chunki ega ham ko'plikda.

tasks.en: They have also got very strong and sharp claws to help them hunt.
tasks.uz: Yana ov qilishga yordam beradigan juda kuchli va o'tkir tirnoqlari bor.
tasks.note:
'to help them hunt' — 'help somebody DO' ('to' YO'Q).
'sharp claws' — Coursebook 41-betda ham bor.

tasks.en: They weigh from three to seven kilos.
tasks.note: 'from ... to ...' — oraliq.

tasks.en: Golden eagles live in forests and mountains in many different parts of the world.
tasks.uz: Oltin burgutlar dunyoning ko'p turli qismlaridagi o'rmon va tog'larda yashaydi.
tasks.note: 'a mountain' = tog'. 'parts of the world' — Coursebook 40-betdagi ibora.

tasks.en: They live alone or in pairs and they eat small birds and mammals.
tasks.uz: Ular yolg'iz yoki juft-juft yashaydi va mayda qush hamda sutemizuvchilarni yeydi.
tasks.note:
'alone' = yolg'iz; 'in pairs' = juft bo'lib.
Delfin va pingvin esa 'in groups' yashaydi.

tasks.en: They live for about twenty years.
tasks.note: 'live FOR + davomiylik'.

tasks.speak: 5  Golden eagles live in forests and mountains.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the questions and match them to the answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarga qarang va ularni javoblarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ SO'ZLARI — TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  WHAT ......... nima?          — narsa, hayvon, ish
  WHERE ........ qayerda?       — joy
  WHEN ......... qachon?        — vaqt
  WHY .......... nega?          — sabab (javob: Because ...)
  WHO .......... kim?           — odam
  WHOSE ........ kimniki?       — egalik
  HOW .......... qanday?        — usul
  HOW LONG ..... qancha uzun? / qancha vaqt?
  HOW TALL ..... qancha baland?
  HOW MUCH ..... qancha? (og'irlik, narx — sanalmaydigan)
  HOW MANY ..... nechta? (sanaladigan)

DIQQAT — 'HOW LONG' IKKI MA'NODA:
  How long is its trunk?   → UZUNLIK (metr)
  How long does it live?   → DAVOMIYLIK (yil)
Qaysi ma'noda ekanini fe'ldan bilib olasiz.

DIQQAT — 'HOW MUCH' vs 'HOW MANY':
  How MUCH does it weigh?      → kilo (sanalmaydi)
  How MANY legs has it got?    → nechta (sanaladi)

SAVOL TUZILISHI (Present Simple, 'it' ega):
  So'roq so'zi + DOES + it + fe'l (asos shakli) + ?
     Where DOES it LIVE?   ('lives' XATO — 'does' bor)
  'be' va 'have got' bilan 'does' KERAK EMAS:
     What IS this animal?   How tall IS it?
     How many legs HAS it got?

exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: deer, fish, goose, mice, oxen, sheep

NOTO'G'RI OTLAR — ko'pligi -s bilan yasalmaydi.

IKKI TURI BOR:
  1) O'ZAK O'ZGARADI:
       goose → geese   (g'oz → g'ozlar)
       mouse → mice    (sichqon → sichqonlar)
       ox    → oxen    (ho'kiz → ho'kizlar)
  2) SHAKL O'ZGARMAYDI:
       sheep → sheep   (qo'y → qo'ylar)
       deer  → deer    (kiyik → kiyiklar)
       fish  → fish    (baliq → baliqlar)

JADVAL:
  SINGULAR (birlik) | PLURAL (ko'plik)
  .........         | geese
  mouse             | .........
  ox                | .........
  .........         | sheep
  deer              | .........
  .........         | fish

tasks.whyUz:
goose → geese. O'zakdagi 'oo' → 'ee' ga o'zgaradi.
Talaffuz: goose /ɡuːs/, geese /ɡiːs/.

mouse → mice. 'mouses' XATO.
Talaffuz: mouse /maʊs/, mice /maɪs/.
DIQQAT: kompyuter sichqonchasi uchun 'mouses' ham ishlatiladi.

ox → oxen. -EN qo'shimchasi bilan ko'plik — juda kam uchraydi.
'children' ham shu turdan.

sheep → sheep. Shakl O'ZGARMAYDI.
'One sheep, ten sheep' — bir xil.
deer → deer. 'deers' XATO. 43-betda yo'lbars 'deer' yeydi.

fish → fish. Shakl o'zgarmaydi.
DIQQAT: 'fishes' — turli TURLARI haqida gapirilganda ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: What are the plurals of these words?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu so'zlarning ko'pligi qanday?
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu to'rttasi — eng ko'p ishlatiladigan noto'g'ri otlar.
Har birini yod olish shart.

tasks.whyUz:
man → men. Talaffuz: man /mæn/, men /men/.
'mans' XATO.

tasks.promptUz: Yozilishi bitta harf o'zgaradi, talaffuzi ko'proq
tasks.whyUz:
woman → women. YOZILISHI: a → e (ikkinchi bo'g'inda).
LEKIN TALAFFUZI birinchi bo'g'inda o'zgaradi:
  woman /ˈwʊmən/ — 'vumen'
  women /ˈwɪmɪn/ — 'vimin'

child → children. 'childs' XATO.
'oxen' kabi -EN bilan tugaydi.

person → people. O'zak BUTUNLAY o'zgaradi.
'persons' ham bor, lekin faqat rasmiy hujjatlarda.
'people' — DOIM ko'plik: 'people ARE' ('people is' XATO).

exercises.instructionEn: Questions with: who, where, why, when, what, how long, how much, how many, how often, how
exercises.instructionUz: So'roq so'zlari: who, where, why, when, what, how long, how much, how many, how often, how
exercises.explanationUz:
O'NTA SO'ROQ SO'ZI VA ULARNING VAZIFASI:

  WHO ......... kim?              — odam
  WHERE ....... qayerda?          — joy
  WHY ......... nega?             — sabab (javob: Because ...)
  WHEN ........ qachon?           — vaqt
  WHAT ........ nima?             — narsa, hayvon, ish
  HOW LONG .... qancha vaqt?      — davomiylik
                qancha uzun?      — uzunlik
  HOW MUCH .... qancha?           — og'irlik, narx, SANALMAYDIGAN miqdor
  HOW MANY .... nechta?           — SANALADIGAN miqdor
  HOW OFTEN ... qanchalik tez-tez? — chastota
  HOW ......... qanday?           — usul, yo'l

SAVOL TUZILISHI:
  So'roq so'zi + DO/DOES + ega + fe'l (asos shakli)?
     Where DO kangaroos LIVE?
     How often DOES a dog EAT?

  'be', 'can', 'have got' bilan DO/DOES KERAK EMAS:
     Who IS Michael?
     What CAN a sea lion do?
     How many legs HAS a lion GOT?

tasks.en: Questions with: who, where, why, when, what, how long, how much, how many, how often, how
tasks.uz: So'roq so'zlari: who, where, why, when, what, how long, how much, how many, how often, how

tasks.en: Who is Michael? — He's my brother.
tasks.note: 'Who' — odam haqida. 'be' bilan 'does' kerak emas.

tasks.en: Where do kangaroos live? — They live in Australia.
tasks.uz: Kengurular qayerda yashaydi? — Ular Avstraliyada yashaydi.
tasks.note: 'Where' — joy. Ko'plik ega → DO.

tasks.en: Why do dolphins learn easily? — Because they're intelligent.
tasks.uz: Nega delfinlar oson o'rganadi? — Chunki ular aqlli.
tasks.note: 'Why' savoliga javob DOIM 'Because' bilan.

tasks.en: When do tigers sleep? — They sleep during the day.
tasks.uz: Yo'lbarslar qachon uxlaydi? — Ular kunduzi uxlaydi.
tasks.note: 'When' — vaqt. 'during the day' = kunduzi.

tasks.en: What do koalas eat? — They eat eucalyptus leaves.
tasks.uz: Koalalar nima yeydi? — Ular evkalipt bargini yeydi.
tasks.note: 'What' — narsa. 'leaf' → 'leaves'.

tasks.en: How long do sea lions live? — They live for about 15 years.
tasks.uz: Dengiz sherlari qancha yashaydi? — Ular taxminan 15 yil yashaydi.
tasks.note: 'How long' — DAVOMIYLIK. Javobda 'for' shart.

tasks.en: How much does an elephant weigh? — About 4,000 kilos.
tasks.note: 'How much' — og'irlik. Birlik ega → DOES + weigh (-s YO'Q).

tasks.en: How many legs has a lion got? — A lion has got four legs.
tasks.uz: Sherning nechta oyog'i bor? — Sherning to'rtta oyog'i bor.
tasks.note: 'How many' — sanaladigan. 'has ... got' bilan 'does' kerak emas.

tasks.en: How often does a dog eat? — Twice a day.
tasks.uz: It qanchalik tez-tez ovqatlanadi? — Kuniga ikki marta.
tasks.note: 'How often' — chastota. 'twice a day' = kuniga ikki marta.

tasks.en: How do kangaroos carry their babies? — In a pouch.
tasks.uz: Kengurular bolalarini qanday olib yuradi? — Xaltada.
tasks.note: Yolg'iz 'How' — USUL so'raydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH:

'mans', 'childs', 'mouses', 'sheeps', 'fishs' — HAMMASI XATO.

tasks.en: Irregular Plurals. Some nouns have irregular plural forms.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and say how many animals you can see, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va nechta hayvon ko'rayotganingizni ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: I can see three giraffes.

QOLIP: I can see + son + hayvon (KO'PLIKDA).

RASMDA 8 XIL HAYVON BOR, JAMI 25 TA:
  baliq (fish) ....... 5
  kapalak (butterfly)  4
  sichqon (mouse) .... 4
  jirafa (giraffe) ... 3
  g'oz (goose) ....... 3
  kiyik (deer) ....... 2
  qo'y (sheep) ....... 2
  ho'kiz (ox) ........ 2

DIQQAT — BU MASHQ ATAYLAB TUZILGAN:
sakkiz hayvonning OLTITASI noto'g'ri ko'plikka ega —
fish, deer, sheep, mice, geese, oxen.
Faqat 'giraffes' va 'butterflies' oddiy qoida bo'yicha yasaladi.

tasks.whyUz:
Rasmda 5 ta baliq. 'fish' — ko'plikda ham FISH.
'five fishes' XATO.
Rasmda 4 ta kapalak. 'butterfly' → 'butterflies' (undosh + y → ies).

Rasmda 4 ta sichqon. 'mouse' → MICE.
'four mouses' XATO.

Rasmda 3 ta g'oz. 'goose' → GEESE.
'three gooses' XATO.

Rasmda 2 ta kiyik (shoxli, oldindan ko'rinadi). 'deer' → DEER.
'two deers' XATO.

exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: How much, Where, What, How long, How

DIQQAT — BA'ZI SO'ZLAR BIR NECHA MARTA ISHLATILADI:
  'What' bu mashqda UCH MARTA kerak bo'ladi.

JAVOBLAR:
  a  All kinds of fish.
  b  Sharp teeth and pointed fins.
  c  1200 kilos.
  d  A White Shark.
  e  30-40 years.
  f  In tropical and warm seas.
  g  3-6 metres.

DIQQAT — 6 va 7 SAVOLNI SOLISHTIRING:
  '...... long IS it?'        → HOW long (uzunlik: metr)
  '...... does it live FOR?'  → HOW LONG (umr: yil)
  6-savolda 'long' ALLAQACHON yozilgan → faqat HOW qo'shiladi.
  7-savolda bo'sh joyga butun 'How long' yoziladi.

tasks.whyUz:
Hayvon nomi so'ralmoqda → WHAT.
Javob: d — A White Shark (oq akula).

Joy so'ralmoqda → WHERE.
Javob: f — In tropical and warm seas (tropik va iliq dengizlarda).

Ovqat so'ralmoqda → WHAT.
Javob: a — All kinds of fish (har xil baliqlar).

Tana qismlari so'ralmoqda → WHAT.
'has it got' bilan 'does' KERAK EMAS.
Javob: b — Sharp teeth and pointed fins (o'tkir tishlar va uchli suzgichlar).

Og'irlik so'ralmoqda → HOW MUCH.
Javob: c — 1200 kilos.

'long' allaqachon bor → faqat HOW qo'shiladi: How long IS it? (uzunlik).
Javob: g — 3-6 metres.

Umr so'ralmoqda → HOW LONG.
'live FOR' — 'for' davomiylikni bildiradi.
Javob: e — 30-40 years.

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI UNLI TOVUSH:

  /e/  — QISQA 'e'. O'zbekcha 'e' ga o'xshaydi.
         Og'iz kam ochiladi, tovush qisqa.
         Yozilishi: e, ea
         Misollar: bed, ten, head, red, pen

  /ɜː/ — UZUN, chuqur tovush. O'zbekchada YO'Q.
         'yo' va 'o' orasidagi, lablar cho'zilmaydi.
         Yozilishi: ir, er, ur, ear, or (w dan keyin)
         Misollar: bird, herd, turn, girl, work, learn

QANDAY FARQLASH:
  Undoshdan keyin R kelsa → ko'pincha /ɜː/
  R bo'lmasa → /e/

  bed  — R yo'q  → /e/
  bird — 'ir'    → /ɜː/
  herd — 'er'    → /ɜː/
  head — R yo'q  → /e/
  ten  — R yo'q  → /e/
  turn — 'ur'    → /ɜː/

tasks.whyUz: bed /bed/ — qisqa 'e'. R harfi yo'q.
bird /bɜːd/ — 'ir' birikmasi uzun chuqur tovush beradi.
herd /hɜːd/ — 'er' birikmasi. 'head' bilan chalkashtirmang!
head /hed/ — 'ea' bu yerda qisqa 'e' beradi. 'herd' dan farqi shu.
ten /ten/ — qisqa 'e'.
turn /tɜːn/ — 'ur' birikmasi uzun chuqur tovush beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in what, who, how many, how long, when, where, why, how much, how often or how.
exercises.instructionUz: what, who, how many, how long, when, where, why, how much, how often yoki how so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
USUL: JAVOBGA QARANG, so'ng savolni tanlang.

  Javob odam           → WHO
  Javob joy            → WHERE
  Javob vaqt           → WHEN
  Javob 'Because ...'  → WHY
  Javob narsa/ish      → WHAT
  Javob 'once/twice/every ...' → HOW OFTEN
  Javob yil/soat (davomiylik)  → HOW LONG
  Javob kilo/pul (sanalmaydi)  → HOW MUCH
  Javob son (sanaladi)         → HOW MANY
  Javob usul (By bus)          → HOW

tasks.prompt: 1  A: "............ do dolphins eat?"  B: "They eat fish."
tasks.whyUz: Javob 'fish' (narsa) → WHAT.
tasks.speak: 1  A: "............ do dolphins eat?"  B: "They eat fish."

tasks.prompt: 2  A: "............ do penguins live?"  B: "In Antarctica."
tasks.whyUz: Javob 'In Antarctica' (joy) → WHERE.
tasks.speak: 2  A: "............ do penguins live?"  B: "In Antarctica."

tasks.prompt: 3  A: "............ do you play football?"  B: "In my free time."
tasks.whyUz: 'In my free time' = bo'sh vaqtimda — bu VAQT → WHEN.
tasks.speak: 3  A: "............ do you play football?"  B: "In my free time."

tasks.prompt: 4  A: "............ do you visit your grandparents?"  B: "Once a month."
tasks.whyUz: 'Once a month' = oyiga bir marta — bu CHASTOTA → HOW OFTEN.
tasks.speak: 4  A: "............ do you visit your grandparents?"  B: "Once a month."

tasks.prompt: 5  A: "............ is that girl over there?"  B: "My sister."
tasks.whyUz: 'My sister' (odam) → WHO. 'be' bilan 'does' kerak emas.
tasks.speak: 5  A: "............ is that girl over there?"  B: "My sister."

tasks.prompt: 6  A: "............ do kangaroos have strong back legs?"  B: "Because they need to jump very high."
tasks.whyUz: Javob 'Because ...' → WHY. Bu eng aniq belgi.
tasks.speak: 6  A: "............ do kangaroos have strong back legs?"  B: "Because they need to jump very high."

tasks.prompt: 7  A: "............ do koalas sleep?"  B: "In the tops of eucalyptus trees."
tasks.whyUz:
'In the tops of eucalyptus trees' (joy) → WHERE.
DIQQAT: 'When do koalas sleep?' savoliga 'during the day' javob bo'lardi.
tasks.speak: 7  A: "............ do koalas sleep?"  B: "In the tops of eucalyptus trees."

tasks.prompt: 8  A: "............ money do you have?"  B: "Not much."
tasks.whyUz:
'money' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → HOW MUCH.
Javob ham 'Not much' — bu ham sanalmaydigan miqdor.
tasks.speak: 8  A: "............ money do you have?"  B: "Not much."

tasks.prompt: 9  A: "............ can a sea lion do?"  B: "It can swim very well."
tasks.whyUz: Javob ISH (swim) → WHAT. 'can' bilan 'does' kerak emas.
tasks.speak: 9  A: "............ can a sea lion do?"  B: "It can swim very well."

tasks.prompt: 10  A: "............ are you smiling?"  B: "Because I'm happy."
tasks.whyUz:
Javob 'Because I'm happy' → WHY.
'to smile' = tabassum qilmoq (40-betdagi 'a smile' — ot).
tasks.speak: 10  A: "............ are you smiling?"  B: "Because I'm happy."

tasks.prompt: 11  A: "............ do you feed your goldfish?"  B: "Every morning."
tasks.whyUz:
'Every morning' = har ertalab — bu CHASTOTA → HOW OFTEN.
'a goldfish' = tilla baliq.
tasks.speak: 11  A: "............ do you feed your goldfish?"  B: "Every morning."

tasks.prompt: 12  A: "............ do tigers live?"  B: "For about fifteen years."
tasks.whyUz: 'For about fifteen years' — DAVOMIYLIK → HOW LONG.
tasks.speak: 12  A: "............ do tigers live?"  B: "For about fifteen years."

tasks.prompt: 13  A: "............ is Mrs Jackson?"  B: "Our neighbour."
tasks.whyUz:
'Our neighbour' (odam) → WHO.
'a neighbour' = qo'shni (britancha yozilishi; amerikacha: neighbor).
tasks.speak: 13  A: "............ is Mrs Jackson?"  B: "Our neighbour."

tasks.prompt: 14  A: "............ colour is your cat?"  B: "Black."
tasks.whyUz: 'What colour ...?' = qanday rangda? — o'zgarmas ibora (44-bet).
tasks.speak: 14  A: "............ colour is your cat?"  B: "Black."

tasks.prompt: 15  A: "............ pieces of pie do you want?"  B: "Only one, please."
tasks.whyUz:
'pieces' — SANALADIGAN ot → HOW MANY. Javob ham son: 'Only one'.
'a piece of pie' = bir bo'lak pirog.
tasks.speak: 15  A: "............ pieces of pie do you want?"  B: "Only one, please."

tasks.whyUz: 'How + sifat' — o'lchov savoli: How TALL are you? (44-betdagi 'How big is it?' kabi).

tasks.prompt: 17  A: "............ do sea lions weigh?"  B: "About 250 kilos."
tasks.whyUz: Og'irlik → HOW MUCH. 45-betdagi dengiz sheri ma'lumoti bilan bir xil.
tasks.speak: 17  A: "............ do sea lions weigh?"  B: "About 250 kilos."

tasks.prompt: 18  A: "............ do you get to school?"  B: "By bus."
tasks.whyUz:
'By bus' — USUL → yolg'iz HOW.
'get to' = yetib bormoq. Transport: BY bus/car/train (artiklsiz).
tasks.speak: 18  A: "............ do you get to school?"  B: "By bus."

tasks.prompt: 19  A: "............ do you sleep at night?"  B: "Eight hours."
tasks.whyUz:
'Eight hours' — DAVOMIYLIK → HOW LONG.
DIQQAT: 'How often' bo'lsa javob 'every night' bo'lardi.
tasks.speak: 19  A: "............ do you sleep at night?"  B: "Eight hours."

tasks.whyUz: 'In Turkey' (joy) → WHERE. Ankara — Turkiya poytaxti.

exercises.instructionUz: who, what, which, where, how long, when, what, how often, how yoki whose so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI YANGI SO'ROQ SO'ZI:

  WHOSE — kimniki? (egalik)
     Whose cat is that? — It's mine.
     Whose are these glasses? — Paul's.
     DIQQAT: 'who's' (= who is) bilan CHALKASHTIRMANG!
       Whose = kimniki (egalik)
       Who's = kim (who is qisqartmasi)
     Ikkalasi bir xil o'qiladi: /huːz/

  WHICH — qaysi biri? (CHEKLANGAN tanlovdan)
     Which colour do you like, red or blue?
     WHAT esa CHEKSIZ tanlovdan so'raydi:
     What colour do you like?

YANA:
  How are you/they? — Ahvol so'raydi (javob: fine, OK).
     Bu 'How do you ...?' (usul) dan FARQ qiladi.

tasks.whyUz:
Javob 'Paul's' (Polniki) — EGALIK → WHOSE.
'glasses' = ko'zoynak (doim ko'plik) yoki stakanlar.

tasks.prompt: 2  A: "............ do dolphins live?"  B: "About fifty years."
tasks.whyUz:
'About fifty years' — DAVOMIYLIK → HOW LONG.
Coursebook 40-betdagi delfin matni bilan bir xil fakt.
tasks.speak: 2  A: "............ do dolphins live?"  B: "About fifty years."

tasks.prompt: 3  A: "............ do tigers eat?"  B: "Deer and monkeys."
tasks.whyUz: Ovqat (narsa) → WHAT. Coursebook 43-betdagi ma'lumot varaqasidan.
tasks.speak: 3  A: "............ do tigers eat?"  B: "Deer and monkeys."

tasks.whyUz:
Javob ODAM ismi → WHO.
DIQQAT: 'How are you?' bo'lsa javob 'I'm fine' bo'lardi.

tasks.prompt: 5  A: "............ are the children?"  B: "They're fine."
tasks.whyUz:
Javob AHVOL ('fine') → HOW.
4-savoldan farqini solishtiring: Who are you? / How are you?
'children' — 'child' ning noto'g'ri ko'pligi.
tasks.speak: 5  A: "............ are the children?"  B: "They're fine."

tasks.prompt: 6  A: "............ animals do you like?"  B: "Dogs and cats."
tasks.whyUz:
Tanlov CHEKSIZ (dunyodagi hamma hayvon) → WHAT animals.
DIQQAT: 'Which animals ...?' ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri —
lekin u CHEKLANGAN ro'yxatdan tanlashni bildiradi
(masalan, rasmda 5 ta hayvon bo'lsa).
tasks.speak: 6  A: "............ animals do you like?"  B: "Dogs and cats."

Coursebook 43-betdagi kenguru matnidan.
tasks.speak: 7  A: "............ do kangaroos sleep?"  B: "During the day."

Coursebook 42-betdagi koala matnidan.
tasks.speak: 8  A: "............ do koalas live?"  B: "In eastern Australia."

Fil kulrang — Coursebook 43-betdagi rasmda ko'rgansiz.
tasks.speak: 9  A: "............ colour is an elephant?"  B: "Grey."

tasks.speak: 10  A: "............ do you wash your dog?"  B: "Once a week."

tasks.prompt: 11  A: "............ tall is your brother?"  B: "About 1.80 metres."

Javob metrda beriladi.
tasks.speak: 11  A: "............ tall is your brother?"  B: "About 1.80 metres."

Hayvon nomi (narsa) → WHAT.

tasks.speak: 12  A: "............ is that animal?"  B: "It's a sea lion."

pouch, brush, koala, sheep, address, child, penguin, dolphin,
man, bench, deer, tiger, foot, fish, woman, goose

     shuning uchun /ɪz/ tovushi qo'shiladi.

  IRREGULAR KATAGI — noto'g'ri otlar (10 ta)
     Yo o'zak o'zgaradi, yo shakl umuman o'zgarmaydi.
     NAMUNA: teeth

-d bilan tugaydi → oddiy -s.
Unli bilan tugaydi → oddiy -s.
-n bilan tugaydi → oddiy -s.
-n bilan tugaydi → oddiy -s.
-r bilan tugaydi → oddiy -s.

-SH bilan tugaydi → -es. 'a brush' = cho'tka.
-SS bilan tugaydi → -es. 'an address' = manzil.

mouse → mice. 'mouses' XATO.

child → children. 'childs' XATO.
man → men. 'mans' XATO.
deer → deer. 'deers' XATO.
foot → feet. 'foots' XATO.

GAPNI KO'PLIKKA O'TKAZISHDA UCH NARSA O'ZGARADI:

  1) EGA (olmosh)
       I    → we      (men → biz)
       you  → you     (sen → siz — O'ZGARMAYDI)
       he   → they    (u → ular)
       she  → they
       it   → they

       am / is → are

       ko'plik shakliga o'tadi
       ARTIKL (a/an) TUSHIB QOLADI!

NAMUNA: She is a doctor. → They are doctors.

DIQQAT: 'They are A doctors' XATO — ko'plikda 'a/an' ishlatilmaydi.

he → they, is → are.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in have got, swim, are, live, weigh or eat.
exercises.instructionUz: have got, swim, are, live, weigh yoki eat so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Polar bears ARE mammals and feed their babies on milk.
  They LIVE in the Arctic. They are about two metres tall
  and they WEIGH about 400 kilos. Polar bears HAVE GOT
  cream-coloured fur which keeps them very warm. They can
  SWIM very well because their front legs are very strong.
  They EAT seals and they usually live on their own and not
  in big groups like many other mammals. They live for about
  twenty-five years.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Oq ayiqlar — sutemizuvchilar va bolalarini sut bilan boqadi.
  Ular Arktikada yashaydi. Ularning bo'yi taxminan ikki metr
  va og'irligi taxminan 400 kilo. Oq ayiqlarning krem rangli
  juni bor, u ularni juda issiq saqlaydi. Ular juda yaxshi
  suza oladi, chunki old oyoqlari juda kuchli. Ular tyulen
  yeydi va odatda yolg'iz yashaydi, boshqa ko'p sutemizuvchilar
  kabi katta guruhlarda emas. Ular taxminan yigirma besh yil
  yashaydi.

QAYSI FE'L QAYERGA — MANTIQ:
  • 'mammals' oldida → 'be' fe'li kerak → ARE
  • 'in the Arctic' (joy) → LIVE
  • 'about 400 kilos' (og'irlik) → WEIGH
  • 'fur' (tana qismi) → HAVE GOT
  • 'can' dan keyin → asos shakli → SWIM
  • 'seals' (ovqat) → EAT

tasks.whyUz:
'live IN + joy'. Ko'plik ega → fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.
'the Arctic' = Arktika (Shimoliy qutb). Artikl THE shart.

tasks.prompt: They are about two metres tall and they 3) ............ about 400 kilos.
tasks.whyUz:
'weigh + og'irlik'. Bo'y uchun 'are ... tall', og'irlik uchun 'weigh'.
DIQQAT: 'they are weigh' XATO — 'weigh' bilan 'be' ishlatilmaydi.
tasks.speak: They are about two metres tall and they 3) ............ about 400 kilos.

tasks.prompt: Polar bears 4) ............ cream-coloured fur which keeps them very warm.
tasks.whyUz:
Tana qismi (fur) → HAVE GOT. Ko'plik ega → HAVE ('has' XATO).
'cream-coloured' = krem rangli. 'which' = ...ki, u.
tasks.speak: Polar bears 4) ............ cream-coloured fur which keeps them very warm.

tasks.prompt: They can 5) ............ very well because their front legs are very strong.
tasks.whyUz:
'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — 'to' va '-s' YO'Q.
Oq ayiq juda yaxshi suzadi.
tasks.speak: They can 5) ............ very well because their front legs are very strong.

tasks.prompt: They 6) ............ seals and they usually live on their own.
tasks.whyUz:
'a seal' = tyulen (dengiz hayvoni). Oq ayiqning asosiy ovqati.
'on their own' = yolg'iz o'zi ('alone' bilan bir xil).
tasks.speak: They 6) ............ seals and they usually live on their own.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to make questions or sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Berilgan so'zlardan savol yoki gap tuzing, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TURDAGI TOPSHIRIQ:

  1) (✓) va (✗) bo'lsa → TASDIQ + INKOR gap:
       There's a bicycle in the garage, BUT there isn't a fridge.

  2) Savol belgisi (?) bo'lsa → SAVOL:
       Are there any flowers in the vase?

THERE IS / THERE ARE QOIDALARI:

  BIRLIK                    KO'PLIK
  There is (There's) a ...  There are some ...
  There isn't a ...         There aren't any ...
  Is there a ...?           Are there any ...?

DIQQAT — SOME va ANY:
  some — TASDIQ gaplarda    (There are some pictures.)
  any  — INKOR va SAVOLLARDA (There aren't any posters.
                              Are there any books?)
  Aniq son bo'lsa some/any KERAK EMAS:
     There are FOUR boys.

tasks.answer: There are some pictures on the walls, but there aren't any posters.
tasks.whyUz:
Ko'plik tasdiq → There are SOME.
Ko'plik inkor → there aren't ANY.
'on the walls' — devor YUZASIDA → ON.

tasks.prompt: 4  a post office / in your area?

Birlik ('a post office') → IS there a ...?

tasks.speak: 4  a post office / in your area?

tasks.answer: There's a fireplace in the living-room, but there isn't a bed.
tasks.whyUz:
Birlik tasdiq → There's A.
Birlik inkor → there isn't A.
'a fireplace' = kamin.

tasks.answer: Are there any books in your bag?
tasks.whyUz: Ko'plik savol → Are there ANY ...?

tasks.prompt: 7  four boys (✓) / in my family / girls (✗)

tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ SON bor ('four') → 'some' QO'SHILMAYDI.
Inkorda esa ANY shart: there aren't ANY girls.
tasks.speak: 7  four boys (✓) / in my family / girls (✗)

tasks.answer: Is there a mirror in your room?

Birlik → IS there A ...?
'a mirror' = oyna (ko'zgu).

Birlik tasdiq → There's a dishwasher.

'a dishwasher' = idish yuvish mashinasi.

tasks.answer: Are there any flats for rent?

Ko'plik savol → Are there ANY ...?

'for rent' = ijaraga.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Hayvonlar haqida umumiy gap KO'PLIKDA aytiladi —
shuning uchun fe'l -s OLMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: They've got + tana qismi. / They haven't got + tana qismi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They've got grey skin and a big smile. They haven't got legs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning kulrang terisi va katta tabassumi bor. Oyog'i yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' — egalik. Ko'plik ega → HAVE/HAVEN'T got.

sentencePatterns.formula: They can / can't + fe'l (asos shakli).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They can swim very well. They can't fly!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular juda yaxshi suza oladi. Ucha olmaydi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — 'to' va '-s' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: They weigh + og'irlik. / They weigh FROM ... TO ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They weigh about twenty kilos. They weigh from seventy to five hundred kilos.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular taxminan yigirma kilo keladi. Yetmishdan besh yuz kilogacha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'weigh' — og'irlikda bo'lmoq. Oraliq uchun 'from ... to ...'.

sentencePatterns.formula: They live IN + joy. They live FOR + davomiylik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They live in warm seas. They live for about fifty years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular iliq dengizlarda yashaydi. Taxminan ellik yil yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Joy uchun IN/ON, umr davomiyligi uchun FOR.

sentencePatterns.formula: They've got ... TO KEEP them warm.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They've also got thick feathers to keep them warm in cold water.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yana sovuq suvda issiq saqlash uchun qalin patlari bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — MAQSAD ('...ish uchun').
'keep somebody warm' — issiq saqlamoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: BOTH X AND Y + fe'l (ko'plik).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Both dolphins and penguins can swim very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar ham, pingvinlar ham juda yaxshi suza oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'both ... and ...' — ikkalasi ham. Fe'l KO'PLIKDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: Hayvon (ko'plik) + are + guruh (ko'plik).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Crocodiles are reptiles. Butterflies are insects.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Timsohlar — sudralib yuruvchilar. Kapalaklar — hasharotlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Turkumlashda ikkala so'z ham KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi.
'A crocodile is a reptile' ham to'g'ri, lekin kitob ko'plikni beradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It has got / They have got + tana qismi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A tiger has got fur, paws and whiskers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'lbarsning juni, panjalari va mo'ylovlari bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlik ega → HAS got. Ko'plik ega → HAVE got.

sentencePatterns.formula: sifat + ot (sifat DOIM ot oldida, -s OLMAYDI).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: thick feathers, a short tail, a big smile, warm seas
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: qalin patlar, kalta dum, katta tabassum, iliq dengizlar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida sifat o'zgarmaydi: 'thickS feathers' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: to + fe'l (maqsad).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: to keep them warm, to lay eggs, to have babies, to look funny
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: issiq saqlash uchun, tuxum qo'yish, bola tug'ish, kulgili ko'rinish
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'to' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — '-s' va '-ing' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: Jadvaldan nutq: kind → unusual → can → have got → weigh → live → eat → live for
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Penguins are birds. They are unusual because they can't fly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pingvinlar — qushlar. Ular g'ayrioddiy, chunki ucha olmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu tartib har qanday hayvon haqida gapirish uchun tayyor reja.

sentencePatterns.formula: I can hear + a + hayvon. / I can't hear + a + hayvon.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can hear a hen. I can't hear a crocodile.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men tovuqni eshitayapman. Men timsohni eshitmayapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l asos shaklida. Hayvon BIRLIKDA, artikl bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Hayvon (ko'plik) + are + wild/farm + animals.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hens are farm animals. Crocodiles are wild animals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tovuqlar — uy hayvonlari. Timsohlar — yovvoyi hayvonlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Turkumlashda ega KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A + hayvon + HAS + bolalari (ko'plik).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A cat has kittens. A duck has ducklings.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mushukning mushukchalari bo'ladi. O'rdakning o'rdakchalari bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlik ega → HAS. Bolalar nomi ko'plikda, artiklsiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: What do they look like? — They have got + tashqi ko'rinish.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do they look like? They have got thick, grey fur and a big, black nose.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular qanday ko'rinadi? Ularning qalin, kulrang juni va katta qora burni bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'look like' = ...ga o'xshamoq, ...day ko'rinmoq.
DIQQAT: 'What do they like?' (nimani yoqtiradi?) — BUTUNLAY boshqa savol.

sentencePatterns.formula: Mothers carry their young IN a pouch FOR the first six months.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mothers carry their young in a small pouch for the first six months of their lives.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Onalari bolasini birinchi olti oy davomida kichik xaltada olib yuradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'young' bu yerda OT — 'bola, bolalari' (hayvonlar haqida).
'for + davomiylik' — necha vaqt davomida.

sentencePatterns.formula: They live alone and eat + ovqat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They live alone and eat eucalyptus leaves.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular yolg'iz yashaydi va evkalipt bargini yeydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'alone' = yolg'iz. 'in groups' ning aksi.
'leaf' → ko'plikda 'leaves' (f → ves).

sentencePatterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + DOES + it + fe'l (asos shakli)?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where does it live? What does it eat? How long does it live?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qayerda yashaydi? U nima yeydi? U qancha yashaydi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'does' bor bo'lsa, asosiy fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.
'Where does it liveS?' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + IS/ARE + ega?  ('does' KERAK EMAS)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is this animal? How tall is it?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu qanday hayvon? U qancha baland?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'li o'zi egadan oldinga chiqadi — yordamchi fe'l kerak emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOW MANY + ot + HAS it GOT?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many legs has it got? — Four.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning nechta oyog'i bor? — To'rtta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' bilan ham 'does' kerak emas: HAS it got.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHY ...? — Because + gap.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why can it jump very high? — Because its back legs are very strong.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nega u baland sakray oladi? — Chunki orqa oyoqlari juda kuchli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Why' savoliga javob DOIM 'Because' bilan boshlanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It weighs about + og'irlik. / It is about + o'lcham + tall.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It weighs about 200 kilos. They are about two metres tall.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U taxminan 200 kilo keladi. Ularning bo'yi taxminan ikki metr.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Og'irlikda 'be' YO'Q: 'It IS weigh' XATO.
Bo'yda esa 'be' SHART va 'tall' oxirida turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: They can + fe'l + BECAUSE + sabab.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They can jump very high because their back legs are very strong.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular baland sakray oladi, chunki orqa oyoqlari juda kuchli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bitta gapda ikki qism: natija + sabab.

sentencePatterns.formula: What colour is it? — It's + rang.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What colour is it? — It's brown.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanday rangda? — U jigarrang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Rang sifat — artikl KERAK EMAS: 'It's A brown' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: How big is it? — It's very/quite + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How big is it? — It's very big.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanchalik katta? — U juda katta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'very' = juda, 'quite' = ancha. Sifat oldida turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: How long IS its tail? — IT'S ... / How long ARE its ears? — THEY'RE ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How long is its tail? — It's very long. How long are its ears? — They're quite short.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dumi qancha uzun? — U juda uzun. Quloqlari qancha uzun? — Ular ancha kalta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
BITTA narsa → IS / IT'S.  IKKITA narsa → ARE / THEY'RE.
Bu eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joy.

sentencePatterns.formula: HAVE + ko'plik ega + GOT + ot? — No, ... haven't got ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have mice got wings? — No, mice haven't got wings.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sichqonlarning qanoti bormi? — Yo'q, sichqonlarning qanoti yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega → HAVE/HAVEN'T got ('has' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: CAN + ko'plik ega + fe'l? — No, ... can't + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can sheep fly? — No, sheep can't fly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qo'ylar ucha oladimi? — Yo'q, qo'ylar ucha olmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' hech qachon -s olmaydi va undan keyin fe'l asos shaklida.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's a + BIRLIK. ... Have + KO'PLIK + got ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's a mouse. Have mice got wings?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu sichqon. Sichqonlarning qanoti bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Rasmdagi BITTA hayvon → birlik.
Butun TUR haqidagi savol → ko'plik.

sentencePatterns.formula: How often do you + fe'l? — ... times a week / every morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How often do you clean it? — Two or three times a week.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uni qanchalik tez-tez tozalaysiz? — Haftada ikki-uch marta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'How often' — chastota savoli. Javobda 'a week' = haftasiga.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's your + hayvon + 's name? — ism.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's your dog's name? — Lady.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Itingizning ismi nima? — Leydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'dog's' — egalik apostrofi. 'What's' — What is qisqartmasi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What kind of + ot + is it? — It's a + tur.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What kind of dog is it? — It's a collie.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu qanday zotdagi it? — Bu kolli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'What kind of ...?' = qanday turdagi? qaysi zot?

sentencePatterns.formula: Is it a male or a female? — It's a male/female.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is it a male or a female? — It's a female.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U erkakmi yoki urg'ochimi? — U urg'ochi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tanlov savoli: A or B. Javobda faqat bittasi aytiladi.
Javobdan keyin olmosh o'zgaradi: female → SHE, male → HE.

sentencePatterns.formula: He's / She's + son + year(s) old.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's two years old. He's one year old.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ikki yoshda. U bir yoshda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 1 yosh → year (birlik). 2 va undan katta → yearS.

sentencePatterns.formula: They live for about X to Y years.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Lions live for about 12 to 16 years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sherlar taxminan 12–16 yil yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Oraliq: 'X to Y'. 'live FOR' — 'for' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + DO/DOES + ega + fe'l (asos shakli)?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where do kangaroos live? How often does a dog eat?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kengurular qayerda yashaydi? It qanchalik tez-tez ovqatlanadi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ko'plik va I/you/we/they → DO.
Birlik (he/she/it, a dog) → DOES.
'does' bor bo'lsa asosiy fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + IS/ARE + ega?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who is Michael? Where is Ankara? How tall are you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Maykl kim? Anqara qayerda? Bo'yingiz qancha?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'li o'zi egadan oldinga chiqadi — DO/DOES kerak emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + CAN + ega + fe'l?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What can a sea lion do?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dengiz sheri nima qila oladi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' ham yordamchi fe'l — DO/DOES qo'shilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOW MANY + ot + HAS/HAVE + ega + GOT?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many legs has a lion got?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sherning nechta oyog'i bor?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' bilan ham DO/DOES kerak emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHY ...? — Because + to'liq gap.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why are you smiling? — Because I'm happy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nega tabassum qilyapsiz? — Chunki men baxtliman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Because' dan keyin ega va fe'l bo'lgan to'liq gap keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHAT + ot + is/are ...? (what colour, what kind, what size)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What colour is your cat? — Black.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mushugingiz qanday rangda? — Qora.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'What' otga birikib, o'sha ot bo'yicha savol beradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHOSE + ot + is/are + this/that/these?  — It's/They're + egalik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Whose cat is that? — It's mine. Whose are these glasses? — Paul's.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kimning mushugi? — Meniki. Bular kimning ko'zoynagi? — Polniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Whose' dan keyin ot kelishi ham, kelmasligi ham mumkin.
Javobda egalik olmoshi (mine, yours) yoki ism + 's.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOW + sifat + is/are + ega?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How tall is your brother? — About 1.80 metres.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Akangizning bo'yi qancha? — Taxminan 1,80 metr.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'How' + tall/big/old/long — o'lchov savoli.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOW + are + ega?  (ahvol)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How are the children? — They're fine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bolalar qalay? — Ular yaxshi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'How are ...?' — SOG'LIQ/AHVOL so'raydi.
'How do you ...?' esa USUL so'raydi. Aralashtirmang.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHAT + ot + do you + fe'l?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What animals do you like? — Dogs and cats.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday hayvonlarni yoqtirasiz? — It va mushuklarni.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'What' otga birikadi va o'sha ot bo'yicha savol beradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ko'plik yasash: ot + -s / -es / noto'g'ri shakl
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: students, actresses, teeth
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: talabalar, aktrisalar, tishlar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval oxirgi harflarga qarang:
  -s/-ss/-sh/-ch/-x/-o → -ES
  noto'g'ri ro'yxatda bormi → NOTO'G'RI SHAKL
  aks holda → -S

sentencePatterns.formula: Ko'plikka o'tkazish: ega + are + ot (ko'plik, artiklsiz).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is a doctor. → They are doctors.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U shifokor. → Ular shifokorlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uch narsa o'zgaradi: ega, 'be' fe'li, ot. Artikl TUSHADI.

sentencePatterns.formula: There's a + BIRLIK ..., but there isn't a + BIRLIK.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There's a bicycle in the garage, but there isn't a fridge.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Garajda velosiped bor, lekin muzlatgich yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' ikki qarama-qarshi qismni bog'laydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are some + KO'PLIK ..., but there aren't any + KO'PLIK.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some pictures on the walls, but there aren't any posters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Devorlarda rasmlar bor, lekin plakatlar yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tasdiqda SOME, inkorda ANY.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is there a ...? / Are there any ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is there a mirror in your room? Are there any flats for rent?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xonangizda oyna bormi? Ijaraga kvartiralar bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlik → IS there A. Ko'plik → ARE there ANY.

sentencePatterns.formula: Javobdan savol tuzish: shaxs almashadi (I↔you, we↔you, my↔your).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, I'm not married. → Are you married? Yes, we are from Holland. → Are you from Holland?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, men uylanmaganman. → Siz uylanganmisiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savolni BOSHQA odam beradi — shuning uchun olmosh almashadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X are mammals ... They live ... They weigh ... They have got ... They can ... They eat ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Polar bears are mammals. They live in the Arctic. They weigh about 400 kilos.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oq ayiqlar — sutemizuvchilar. Ular Arktikada yashaydi. Taxminan 400 kilo keladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Hayvon tavsifining standart tartibi (Coursebook 40–45-betlar bilan bir xil).

sentencePatterns.formula: The + ot + is/are + predlog + the + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The pictures are on the wall. The rug is under the table.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Suratlar devorda. Gilam stol ostida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ot ko'plikda bo'lsa ARE, birlikda bo'lsa IS.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ism + 'S + ot  (egalik)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Daniel's father, my mother's sister, Sean's desk
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Danielning otasi, onamning singlisi, Shonning stoli
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Egalik apostrofi EGAGA qo'yiladi, narsaga emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ism1 and Ism2's + ot  (bitta umumiy narsa)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: John and Lisa's car, Robyn and Tim's computer
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon va Lizaning mashinasi, Robin va Timning kompyuteri
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Narsa BITTA va umumiy bo'lsa, 's faqat oxirgi ismga.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are some + ko'plik ... (tasdiq)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some pillows on the bed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Karavotda bir nechta yostiq bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tasdiq gapda SOME, inkor va savolda ANY.

sentencePatterns.formula: egalik sifati + ot   /   fe'l + egalik olmoshi
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is her car. This car is hers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu — uning mashinasi. Bu mashina uniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: OT bor bo'lsa — her/my/your. OT yo'q bo'lsa — hers/mine/yours.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + never + fe'l (inkor ma'no, 'not' KERAK EMAS)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She never works on Sundays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hech qachon yakshanba ishlamaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'never' o'zi inkor qiladi — 'doesn't never work' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: X have got + tana qismi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dolphins have got fins. Elephants have got a trunk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Delfinlarda suzgich bor. Fillarda xartum bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega → HAVE got. Birlik ega → HAS got.

sentencePatterns.formula: X lay eggs. / X have babies and feed their young on milk.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Birds and reptiles both lay eggs. Mammals have babies.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qushlar ham, sudralib yuruvchilar ham tuxum qo'yadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'both' = ikkalasi ham; egadan keyin, fe'ldan oldin turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X are + sifat + TO + odam.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dogs are friendly to people.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Itlar odamlarga do'stona.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'friendly TO' — predlog o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X can learn how to + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dolphins can easily learn how to play games.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar o'yin o'ynashni oson o'rgana oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'how to + fe'l' = ...ishni. Fe'l ASOS shaklida.

sentencePatterns.formula: They are small creatures. They have got + belgi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are small creatures. They have got six legs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular kichik jonzotlar. Oltita oyog'i bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ta'rif berish qolipi: avval turi, keyin belgilari.

sentencePatterns.formula: I can see + son + hayvon (ko'plik).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can see three giraffes. I can see four mice.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men uchta jirafa ko'ryapman. Men to'rtta sichqon ko'ryapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sondan keyin ot DOIM ko'plikda.
Noto'g'ri otlarda ko'plik shakli maxsus: mice, geese, oxen, fish, deer, sheep.

sentencePatterns.formula: Hayvon (ko'plik) + have got + very/quite + sifat + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Deer have got quite long legs. Koalas have got very sharp claws.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kiyiklarning ancha uzun oyog'i bor. Koalalarning juda o'tkir tirnog'i bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tartib: have got → very/quite → sifat → ot.

sentencePatterns.formula: Hayvon (ko'plik) + CAN / CAN'T + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dolphins can't fly. Penguins can swim.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar ucha olmaydi. Pingvinlar suza oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' o'zgarmaydi va undan keyin fe'l asos shaklida ('to' YO'Q).

sentencePatterns.formula: Turkumlash: hayvonlarni guruhga ajratish.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Crocodiles and snakes are reptiles. Dolphins, cows and lions are mammals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Timsoh va ilon — sudralib yuruvchilar. Delfin, sigir va sher — sutemizuvchilar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Sanashda oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and', qolganida vergul.

sentencePatterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + DO/DOES + ega + fe'l?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where do green turtles live? How much do they weigh?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yashil toshbaqalar qayerda yashaydi? Ular qancha og'irlikda?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Oddiy fe'l bilan savolda DO/DOES shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: What/Why + HAVE + ega + GOT?  ('do' KERAK EMAS)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What have they got? Why have they got big eyes?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda nima bor? Nega ularning katta ko'zi bor?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' o'zi yordamchi fe'l vazifasini bajaradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X have got ... TO + fe'l (maqsad).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have got a shell to protect them. They have got big eyes to help them see well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning himoya qiladigan qobig'i bor. Yaxshi ko'rish uchun katta ko'zi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — nima uchun kerakligini bildiradi.
'help somebody DO' — 'to' YO'Q: help them SEE.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do you like + hayvon? — Yes, I love ... / No, I hate ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you like dogs? — Yes, I love dogs. They're very friendly animals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Itlarni yoqtirasizmi? — Ha, men itlarni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Ular juda do'stona hayvonlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ijobiy javob: Yes + LOVE. Salbiy javob: No + HATE.

sentencePatterns.formula: I think + (that) + ega + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think they're very dangerous.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, ular juda xavfli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'I think' — o'z fikrini bildirish. 'that' tushirilishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: They spend most of their time + joy/ish.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They spend most of their time in the sea.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular vaqtining ko'pini dengizda o'tkazadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'spend time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq. 'most of' = ko'p qismi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do you like + hayvon? — Oh, yes. I like ... / No, I don't. I think they're ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you like monkeys? — Oh, yes. I like monkeys. They're funny.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Maymunlarni yoqtirasizmi? — Ha, albatta. Men maymunlarni yoqtiraman. Ular kulgili.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'love/hate' dan yumshoqroq variant: 'like' va 'don't like'.

sentencePatterns.formula: What kind of + hayvon + is he/she? — He's/She's a + zot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What kind of cat is he? — He's a Persian.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanday zotdagi mushuk? — U fors mushugi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Jinsi ma'lum bo'lgach 'it' o'rniga 'he' yoki 'she' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: They lay eggs and keep them in a nest.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They lay eggs and keep them in a nest.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular tuxum qo'yadi va uni uyada saqlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'them' oldingi otga ishora qiladi (bu yerda 'eggs').

sentencePatterns.formula: They have got ... TO HELP them + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have got sharp claws to help them hunt.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ov qilishga yordam beradigan o'tkir tirnoqlari bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'help somebody DO' — 'to' QO'YILMAYDI: help them HUNT.

sentencePatterns.formula: They live alone or in pairs.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They live alone or in pairs and they eat small birds and mammals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular yolg'iz yoki juft yashaydi va mayda qush va sutemizuvchilarni yeydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'alone' predlogsiz, 'in pairs' esa IN bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Jadvaldan matnga: har qator bitta gapga aylanadi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Kind of animal: mammal → Orang-utans are mammals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hayvon turi: sutemizuvchi → Orangutanlar — sutemizuvchilar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Jadvalda birlik bo'lsa ham, matnda ega KO'PLIKDA yoziladi.
